supersedes: PREREGISTRATION_forgery.json and PREREGISTRATION_control_v2.json (both control attempts failed absolute gates; diagnosis: run-to-run drift and transpilation-layout variance at low contrast dominate absolute thresholds)
design_rationale: Both arms (non-normal CTC ansatz + normal control ansatz) run as 16 pubs in ONE job: one calibration snapshot, identical pinned initial layout [53,54,55] (the qubits of the confirmed v2 run) and fixed transpiler seed 42. Common drift cancels in paired ratio statistics. The control ansatz is re-optimized: exactly normal (3e-13) with single-potential contrast 1.318 (vs 0.862 in v1/v2 controls) for variance-explained headroom.
calibration_disclosure: Ratio gates are calibrated from the historical cross-session values (R_D 3.4 and 4.4; R_A 1.85 and 4.1) and set below both; CTC-arm structure gates repeat v2's. Tested on fresh data.
experiment: 16 pubs x 20k shots, ONE job, ibm_marrakesh, layout [53,54,55], seed_transpiler 42
analysis_script: hardware/analyze_paired.py, unmodified (gates embedded there must match)

decision_criteria.confirmed: ALL of: 16/16 cells both arms; R_D = max|D_ii|(ctc)/max|D_ii|(control) >= 3.0; R_A = antisym(ctc)/antisym(control) >= 1.5; CTC arm VE >= 0.90 AND r(D,D_th) >= 0.95
decision_criteria.not_confirmed: any gate missed - report prominently, no reinterpretation
decision_criteria.secondary_reported_nongating: control-arm single-potential VE, max|D_ii|, antisymmetry, r vs predicted v_j - v_i

no_post_hoc_changes: Any deviation from this plan is exploratory and must be labelled so.
